unique_programs: Hopkins Hospital/Medical School access for undergrads
academic_programs.curriculum_structure: Distribution requirements + Major, flexible second major/minor

historical_admit_patterns.common_profiles: STEM-focused, especially pre-med and research-oriented students

korean_specific_advice: Hopkins is THE pre-med school - if interested, highlight research and clinical experience
Research opportunities are unparalleled - mention specific labs/professors
The Baltimore community and service opportunities matter - show engagement
Can be competitive/intense - show you thrive in that environment
Biomedical engineering is flagship program - very Korean-popular
common_korean_applicant_mistakes: Only focusing on pre-med without showing broader interests
Not demonstrating genuine research experience or interest
Essays that seem too narrowly focused on med school admission
Not addressing Baltimore's challenges and opportunities
Appearing too competitive without collaborative spirit

campus_life.dining_options: Multiple dining halls, Charles Village restaurants nearby
campus_life.safety_rating: Good on campus - Blue Jay Shuttle, security escorts
campus_life.nearby_attractions: DC (45 min), Inner Harbor, Fells Point, Baltimore food scene

career_outcomes.korean_alumni_network: Strong JHU Korean Alumni network, especially in medicine
